metadata.topic: A Guardian Rises: ending, end-of-mission screens and Continue
metadata.description: The opening mission plays its ending cinematic, shows the end-of-mission screens with the Guardian's results, and Continue now leaves them and loads the Guardian into a world.
metadata.previous_state: The mission stopped at Clear Out the Fallen; after the cinematic the screen stayed black.
metadata.current_state: All eight hangar groups clear; outro plays in full; end-of-mission screens show server-provided results; holding Continue launches the next story activity and spawns the Guardian in a world.
metadata.remaining_issue: Destination world is the server default, not the Tower; advancement tab empty; loading indicator remains; values synthetic.
metadata.next_task: Serve the correct world for the next story activity and arrive in the Tower.
metadata.audio: game audio only, one emulator port; music may be present
